name: land_area
description: Acres of land on the farm (shared by heifers and dairy cows and by grain and sugar beet)

name: housing_capacity
description: Cow places in the existing housing (heifers and dairy cows; cows sold at the sale age need none)

name: heifer_acres
description: Acres needed to support one heifer for a year (two thirds of an acre)

name: cow_acres
description: Acres needed to support one dairy cow for a year

name: beet_yield
description: Tons of sugar beet harvested per acre (any acre of the farm can grow sugar beet)

name: grain_per_cow
description: Tons of grain eaten by one dairy cow in a year

name: beet_per_cow
description: Tons of sugar beet eaten by one dairy cow in a year

name: heifer_labour_hours
description: Labour hours needed per heifer per year

name: cow_labour_hours
description: Labour hours needed per dairy cow per year

name: grain_labour_hours
description: Labour hours needed per acre of grain per year

name: beet_labour_hours
description: Labour hours needed per acre of sugar beet per year

name: regular_labour_hours
description: Labour hours covered by the regular labour cost each year

name: regular_labour_cost
description: Yearly cost of the regular labour (paid whatever the plan)

name: overtime_cost
description: Cost of each labour hour beyond the regular hours

name: heifer_death_rate
description: Share of heifers that die each year (applied to calves raised and to one-year-old heifers)

name: cow_death_rate
description: Share of dairy cows that die each year

name: calves_per_cow
description: Calves born per dairy cow per year

name: heifer_calf_share
description: Share of calves born that are heifers; the rest are bullocks sold at birth

name: bullock_price
description: Price of a bullock calf sold shortly after birth

name: heifer_calf_price
description: Price of a heifer calf sold at birth instead of being raised

name: cull_cow_price
description: Price of a cow sold at the sale age (12 years)

name: milk_revenue_per_cow
description: Yearly revenue from the milk of one dairy cow

name: grain_purchase_price
description: Price paid per ton of grain bought

name: grain_sale_price
description: Price received per ton of grain sold

name: beet_purchase_price
description: Price paid per ton of sugar beet bought

name: beet_sale_price
description: Price received per ton of sugar beet sold

name: heifer_upkeep
description: Other yearly cost per heifer

name: cow_upkeep
description: Other yearly cost per dairy cow

name: grain_acre_cost
description: Other yearly cost per acre of grain

name: beet_acre_cost
description: Other yearly cost per acre of sugar beet

name: housing_installment
description: Yearly loan repayment per extra cow place (each place costs 200 and is financed by a loan repaid in equal yearly instalments; book value at 15% over 10 years)

name: loan_term_years
description: Number of equal yearly repayments of the housing loan; repayments still due after the last planning year are charged to the plan

name: min_final_dairy_cows
description: Fewest dairy cows allowed in the last planning year (half of today's 100)

name: max_final_dairy_cows
description: Most dairy cows allowed in the last planning year (today's 100 plus 75%)

name: min_yearly_profit
description: Lowest profit (cash flow after loan repayments) allowed in any year; 0 = no year may make a loss
